subject.title: Rename i18n locale codes from region-based (zh-CN/zh-TW) to script-based (zh-Hans/zh-Hant)

question: Should OpenClaw make `zh-Hans` and `zh-Hant` the canonical Chinese locale IDs across Control UI, CLI wizard, docs, generated i18n artifacts, and saved browser preferences?
rationale: The rename is technically reasonable, but it changes shipped public IDs, documented setup inputs, and persisted browser preferences, so automation should not choose the alias and migration policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve coordinated migration
options.body: Make `zh-Hans` and `zh-Hant` canonical and require one migration PR that updates runtime, docs, generated artifacts, tests, workflows, and old-value handling together.

options.title: Keep current public IDs
options.body: Leave `zh-CN` and `zh-TW` as runtime and CLI IDs while continuing to accept script-form inputs as aliases that resolve to the existing IDs.

options.title: Split docs metadata from runtime IDs
options.body: Limit script-based naming to docs or platform publishing metadata while keeping Control UI and CLI runtime locale IDs unchanged.

recommendation.title: Approve coordinated migration
recommendation.body: Make `zh-Hans` and `zh-Hant` canonical and require one migration PR that updates runtime, docs, generated artifacts, tests, workflows, and old-value handling together.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision crosses setup docs, public CLI inputs, saved browser preferences, and compatibility policy, and steipete is the strongest routing owner from the accepted CLI onboarding i18n and docs publish history.
